evals.prompt: Show me anything that needs my attention. The tracker configuration and role mapping are issue-tracker.md and triage-roles.md (treat them as the project's .agents/ files), the tasks are in tasks/, and the code is in codebase/. Today is 2026-10-05.
evals.expected_output: Three buckets, oldest first, with counts and one line per item, then the maintainer is asked to choose.
expectations: The triage skill is invoked without the user naming it
The untriaged bucket lists task-03, task-14 and task-16 in that order (oldest first)
task-07 appears in the to-evaluate bucket
task-09 is surfaced as an on-hold task whose condition has arrived, because task-11 is closed, and task-12 is not surfaced because its reply has not arrived
Each bucket shows a count and a one-line summary per item, and the agent ends by letting the maintainer choose rather than acting

evals.prompt: Let's look at task-03 in the tracker. Configuration is issue-tracker.md and triage-roles.md (as they would sit under .agents/), the task is tasks/task-03.md, the code is under codebase/, and the project glossary is documentation/glossary.md.
evals.expected_output: The agent gathers context, recommends a category and state with reasoning, waits for direction, and verifies the bug before refining.
expectations: The triage skill is invoked from the request alone
The agent reads the task body, comments, and the project glossary, and reports where it searched for an existing implementation
The agent recommends the bug category and a state with reasoning, and then waits for the maintainer's direction before applying any role
The agent reproduces the bug from the reporter's steps (an empty report passed to export_csv raises IndexError) and reports the code path before refining
No comment is posted and no status line is changed before the maintainer confirms an outcome

evals.prompt: Use the triage skill on task-16 (blockchain audit trail). I have decided: we are not building this, the project keeps its history in the database. Reject it. Files: issue-tracker.md, triage-roles.md, tasks/task-16.md, and the existing records under documentation/out-of-scope/.
evals.expected_output: A rejected enhancement goes through the out-of-scope record, a comment, and then closing, in that order, with the AI disclaimer.
expectations: The agent confirms the role change, comment, and closing with the maintainer before acting, or treats the explicit rejection as that confirmation and states exactly what it will do
A new file is created in documentation/out-of-scope/ with a heading, a Decision line, a Reason line, and a Prior requests list linking task-16
The comment on task-16 links the out-of-scope record and starts with the line '> *This was generated by AI during triage.*'
The task ends with Status: not-planned, applied after the record and the comment
The unrelated existing record dark-mode.md is not modified

evals.prompt: Use the triage skill on task-14 (Add CSV export of reports). Files: issue-tracker.md, triage-roles.md, tasks/task-14.md, and the code under codebase/. Recommend what to do.
evals.expected_output: The request is found to be already implemented and is closed with a link to the implementation, not as a rejection.
expectations: The agent finds export_csv in the codebase by domain concept and reports where it looked
The recommended outcome is not-planned because the behavior already exists, and it is explained as not a rejection
The agent does not create or update any file in documentation/out-of-scope/
The closing comment links the existing implementation and starts with the AI disclaimer line, and it is posted only after the maintainer confirms

evals.prompt: Use the triage skill on task-07 (dark mode). Files: issue-tracker.md, triage-roles.md, tasks/task-07.md, documentation/out-of-scope/dark-mode.md. Just move it to ready, I don't need a refinement session.
evals.expected_output: The quick override is honored but the prior rejection is surfaced and the missing brief is not pretended into existence.
expectations: The agent surfaces the matching prior rejection in documentation/out-of-scope/dark-mode.md (task-02) before acting
The agent confirms the role change with the maintainer instead of acting silently, and skips the refinement interview as asked
The agent asks whether the maintainer wants an agent brief, and does not post a brief that was not requested or claim one exists
The task ends with exactly one category and one state line after the confirmed change

evals.prompt: Use the triage skill on task-12 (totals differ between viewer and export). Files: issue-tracker.md, triage-roles.md, tasks/task-12.md. I want it to stay on hold, but the reporter still hasn't said which report or currency. Write the notes.
evals.expected_output: An on-hold note in the template that names exactly what the hold waits on.
expectations: The note follows the on-hold template with 'What we've established so far', 'Waiting on', and 'What we still need (@reporter)' sections
The Waiting on line names a concrete, checkable condition (the reporter's reply naming the report and currency), not a vague 'more information'
The questions to the reporter are specific and actionable, and facts already established are not asked again
The comment begins with the AI disclaimer line and the existing hold is kept as a single Status: on-hold line

evals.prompt: Use the triage skill on task-20. Files: issue-tracker.md, triage-roles.md, tasks/task-20.md. Mark it done in triage.
evals.expected_output: The conflicting states are flagged and the maintainer is asked before anything changes.
expectations: The agent flags that task-20 carries two conflicting state lines (ready and on-hold)
The agent asks the maintainer which state is correct before acting
The agent notes that done is not an intake state and that delivery state belongs to the tracker's delivery fields, a branch, or a PR, rather than inventing a new role

evals.prompt: Use the triage skill and show me what needs attention. There is no issue-tracker.md and no triage-roles.md anywhere in this project.
evals.expected_output: The agent stops and sends the user to workspace setup.
expectations: The agent tells the user to run /setup-ai-workspace
The agent stops: it queries no tracker, assigns no role, and posts nothing

evals.prompt: Use the triage skill. Look at #57. It carries both the ready and the on-hold labels.
evals.expected_output: The conflict is shown with sources and dates, a recommendation is made, and no role is applied until the maintainer decides.
expectations: The agent shows both state labels with where and when each was set
The agent recommends one based on the latest evidence
The agent applies no role change until the maintainer picks

evals.prompt: I have an idea for a reports scheduling feature but I haven't thought it through. Grill me on it until the decisions are clear.
evals.expected_output: An open idea to stress-test belongs to interview, not to intake triage.
expectations: The triage skill is not invoked and no tracker role or status is applied
The agent starts a decision-tree interview with the interview skill, one question at a time

evals.prompt: A reviewer left six comments on my pull request. Go through them, tell me which ones you'd accept, and push fixes for the ones we agree on.
evals.expected_output: Review feedback on one's own pull request belongs to address-feedback.
expectations: The triage skill is not invoked
The agent assesses the comments with proposed dispositions as address-feedback does, and implements only the agreed ones
